saints.name: Valentine
saints.legacy: Patron saint of love and affection
saints.summary: Valentine was a priest in Rome who became a martyr during the persecution under Emperor Claudius II around the year 268. Known for his courage, he openly preached the Christian faith and performed miracles, including restoring sight to a blind girl. His legacy as a symbol of love and devotion has led to his celebration on February 14, which is now widely recognized as Valentine's Day.
